summary: The user's own profile and settings hub: identity header, three activity counters, saved research, an editable watchlist, notification preferences, language, and sign-out. It is the fourth bottom-nav destination and the only screen that combines read-only profile content with live preference controls.

sections.name: Phone frame + scroll container (shared, context only)
sections.description: Every screen sits inside a 390x844 phone shell. The shell itself is `position:relative;width:390px;height:844px;border-radius:46px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EDE8E2 0%,#E3DCD4 100%);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(27,25,23,.20),0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.07)` (line 46). The scroll region is `position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;padding:54px 16px 124px;box-sizing:border-box` (line 53) — scrollbars hidden. So usable content width = 390 - 32 = 358px (computed, not read). Top inset 54px clears the status bar; bottom inset 124px clears the 66px nav bar sitting 22px off the bottom. Status bar (line 48-51): absolute top:0 left:0 right:0, height 54px, z-index 6, flex space-between, padding 0 26px, pointer-events:none, font `500 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic'`, color #1B1917, font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Left span "9:41". Right span is flex gap 5px with three bars: 16x9 radius 2px bg #1B1917 opacity .85; 5x9 radius 1px opacity .5; 22x10 radius 3px opacity .85.
sections.layout: shell 390x844, radius 46px; scroll padding 54px 16px 124px; content width 358px; status bar height 54px, padding 0 26px

interactions: Screen entry: `animation:bRise 240ms ease-out` on the root column — opacity 0→1 and translateY 4px→0 (keyframe at line 19). It runs on the whole column as one unit; there is no per-item stagger.

Notification toggle tap (line 680, handler at line 916): flips one boolean in `state.notif`. Initial state is `[true, false, false]` (line 819) — row 1 ON, rows 2 and 3 OFF. The CSS transition is `all 220ms ease-out` on the track, which animates the background colour; the knob position changes via `justify-content` and therefore SNAPS in the canvas. In Flutter, animate both: 220ms, ease-out, colour and 18px knob travel together.

Dark saved-research card tap (line 636): `p.goReader` → navigates to the Research Reader screen. Crucially `goReader` is defined as `g('reader')` with NO nav argument (line 880), so the bottom-nav selection STAYS on You while the reader is open, and `prev` is set to 'you' so Back returns here (line 881). Do not switch the nav pill to Home for this route.

The dark card has cursor:pointer but — uniquely among the goReader cards in this file — no press-scale. Every other instance (lines 71, 198, 376, 384, 440) has `transition:transform 220ms ease-out` + `style-active="transform:scale(0.98)"`. Recommend adding the same 220ms ease-out scale(0.98) press state here for consistency; call it out as an intentional deviation from the canvas.
Light saved-research card: NO onClick, no cursor:pointer, no press state. Inert in the canvas — decide whether it should route to a reader too.
"Edit" (line 650): plain text, no onClick, no cursor:pointer, no underline, no chip. Inert in the canvas — the intent is clearly an edit/reorder mode for the watchlist but no target state exists.

Drag handle (lines 655-659): visual only at opacity .35, no drag wiring in the canvas. If you implement reorder, the handle is the grab target and the row should lift; no lift/shadow/placeholder styling was specified — you will be inventing it.
Remove chip "−" (line 665): no onClick in the canvas. No confirm dialog, no undo affordance, no swipe-to-delete alternative specified.
Stat tiles, Language row, and Sign out: no onClick, no cursor:pointer, no pressed/hover state anywhere in the canvas.

Bottom nav pill: `animation:bPill 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1)` — the keyframe (line 20) only fades opacity 0→1; the overshoot curve is on the fade, and the pill's position is a static translateX(300%) per tab, so there is no sliding motion in the canvas. In Flutter, an AnimatedPositioned/AnimatedAlign slide with that same 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) is the natural upgrade — flag as a deliberate enhancement.

No pull-to-refresh, no scroll-to-top-on-tab-retap, no scroll-linked header collapse, no skeleton/loading state for this screen. The STATES screen (lines 696-751) covers empty/loading/error/reported patterns generally, including an "Empty watchlist" state at line 710 — I did not read its styling, so specify the You-screen empty watchlist from that block rather than inventing one.
No hover states are meaningful (touch target).
flutterNotes:
STRUCTURE. Root: Stack over the phone-body gradient → CustomScrollView/SingleChildScrollView with padding EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 54, 16, 124), then the nav scrim and glass bar as Positioned children on top. Body content is a Column with 22px gaps — use `Column(children: [...].withGap(22))` or explicit SizedBox(height:22) between the seven blocks; do NOT reach for ListView.separated, the blocks are heterogeneous and fixed in number. Entry animation: wrap the Column in a single AnimatedOpacity+SlideTransition, 240ms, Curves.easeOut, offset 4px→0 — one controller for the whole column, not per child.

TEXT STYLES. `font:300 28px/1.1 Outfit` maps to TextStyle(fontFamily:'Outfit', fontWeight:FontWeight.w300, fontSize:28, height:1.1, letterSpacing:-0.02*28 = -0.56). CSS `letter-spacing` in `em` must be multiplied by the font size — .16em at 11px = 1.76px, .14em at 10px = 1.4px, .02em at 15px = 0.3px. CSS `line-height:1` = height:1.0 in Flutter but Flutter still applies font ascent/descent differently; for the single-line numeric/label cases (11px/1, 13px/1, 14px/1) consider `height: 1.0` plus `leadingDistribution: TextLeadingDistribution.even` to match the tight CSS boxes. `text-transform:uppercase` has no Flutter equivalent — uppercase the strings in code (`'Saved research'.toUpperCase()`), and make that a localization-aware helper because it must be a no-op in Arabic. `font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums` → `fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]` on the stat values, the watchlist prices, and the status-bar clock.

CARDS AND SHADOWS. Every light surface is the same recipe: Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFFF7F4F0), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20 or 24), boxShadow: [BoxShadow(color: Color(0x0F1B1917) /* rgba(27,25,23,.06) */, blurRadius: 24, offset: Offset(0,8))])). Note CSS blur 24 ≈ Flutter blurRadius 24 is close enough here; if it reads heavier, halve to 12 — CSS blur radius is roughly 2σ while Flutter's is σ-ish. Make ONE `PaperCard` widget with a radius parameter; radius 20 for stat tiles + Language row, radius 24 for grouped cards + research cards. The dark research card is a BoxDecoration with LinearGradient(begin: topCenter, end: bottomCenter, colors:[Color(0xFF242120), Color(0xFF1B1917)]) and NO shadow.

ROW DIVIDERS. `box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0` is not a Flutter shadow — it is a 1px line drawn inside the bottom of the row that does not add height. Implement as the row's own `decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: Color(0x141B1917), width: 1)))` and then subtract nothing from the padding (CSS box-shadow does not affect layout, but a Flutter Border DOES add to the container's size unless you use a DecoratedBox behind the padded child — safest is a Stack/CustomPaint, or accept the 1px and reduce bottom padding to 13/15). The canvas draws this divider on the LAST row too, inside the card's 4px bottom padding; decide explicitly whether to reproduce that or drop the trailing divider, and say which you chose.

AVATAR STRIPE. `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 4px,#E8E2DB 4px 8px)` has no direct Flutter equivalent. Options: (a) CustomPainter drawing 45° bands of 4px in a ClipOval — most faithful; (b) a tiny 8x8 tileable asset with ImageRepeat; (c) a LinearGradient with hard colour stops repeated — brittle. Recommend (a). This is a placeholder-avatar pattern, so it should also be the fallback when a real user photo is absent.

TOGGLE. Do not use CupertinoSwitch or Switch — neither matches (46x28 track, 22px knob, 3px inset, #E8621C fill). Build it: GestureDetector → AnimatedContainer(duration: 220ms, curve: Curves.easeOut, width:46, height:28, padding: EdgeInsets.all(3), decoration: pill with color ON Color(0xFFE8621C) / OFF Color(0x1F1B1917)) containing AnimatedAlign(duration: 220ms, curve: Curves.easeOut, alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart/centerEnd) → the 22px white knob with BoxShadow(color: Color(0x331B1917), blurRadius: 6, offset: Offset(0,2)). Use AlignmentDirectional so RTL flips the knob automatically, exactly as CSS justify-content does. PRODUCT BLOCKER: ON and OFF are distinguished only by colour and knob position — no glyph, no label. That breaks the never-colour-alone rule. Minimum fix: render the state word ("On"/"Off", localized) next to the track, or put a check/dash glyph in the knob. Do not ship the canvas version as-is; raise it.

WATCHLIST ROW. Row(children:[handle (flex none), Expanded(Column(crossAxisAlignment: start, ticker + 3px + Arabic name)), price, 26px chip]) with 14px gaps — in Flutter that means explicit SizedBox(width:14) between the four children, since Row has no gap. Expanded + `overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, maxLines: 1` reproduces `flex:1;min-width:0`. Price and ticker use Outfit; the Arabic name uses IBM Plex Sans Arabic at weight 300.

REORDER. If the drag handle becomes live, ReorderableListView will not work inside this scroll view without a shrinkWrap/nested-scroll workaround — prefer ReorderableListView with `buildDefaultDragHandles: false` + `ReorderableDragStartListener(index:…)` wrapping the 3-bar handle, placed as a shrinkWrapped, physics: NeverScrollableScrollPhysics child of the outer scroll view. No lift/drop visual was specified in the canvas, so pick something restrained (scale 1.02 + the existing card shadow) and flag it as invented.

NAV BAR GLASS. `backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(180%)` → ClipRRect(borderRadius: 999) + BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX:26, sigmaY:26)) with a Container(color: Color(0x941B1917)). Flutter has no saturate() in ImageFilter — either accept the loss or compose ColorFilter.matrix for saturation inside the BackdropFilter's filter chain. The inset highlights (`0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.30) inset`, `0 -8px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.05) inset`) are not expressible as BoxShadow — draw them with a CustomPainter or a stacked gradient overlay, or approximate with a 1px top gradient line (the separate top-hairline div at line 767 already does the visible part of that job). BackdropFilter is expensive; keep it in a RepaintBoundary and do not rebuild it on toggle taps.

NAV ICONS. All four are trivial shapes; do not ship them as SVG assets — CustomPainter or nested Containers is cheaper. You icon at 21x21 rendered from a 20x20 viewBox means scale factor 1.05: circle centre (10.5,7.35) r 3.78, rect (3.675, 13.02) 13.65x6.3 rx 3.15 in the 21px box. The shoulder rect is at opacity .7 of the current colour, the head at full.

RTL / ARABIC — this screen is one of the most direction-sensitive in the app.
• Every Row/padding on this screen must use EdgeInsetsDirectional and AlignmentDirectional, not left/right. Affected: drag handle (leading) → remove chip (trailing); Edit (trailing in section header); Language value (trailing); the toggle (trailing); the PRO badge if it existed.
• Letter-spacing MUST be dropped to 0 for Arabic text — .16em/.14em/.12em tracking breaks Arabic glyph joining. Gate it: `letterSpacing: isArabic ? 0 : 1.76`.
• `text-transform:uppercase` is a no-op in Arabic; ensure the helper skips it rather than calling toUpperCase on Arabic strings.
• The watchlist rows already mix directions inside an LTR row (`dir="rtl"` on the Arabic name at line 662). In an Arabic build the row itself flips, and the ticker (Latin, "SWDY") becomes the embedded LTR run. Wrap ticker and price in `Directionality(textDirection: TextDirection.ltr)` or rely on `textDirection: TextDirection.ltr` on the Text — otherwise "65.42" and "SWDY" will reorder unpredictably next to Arabic neighbours.
• "EN · العربية" is a mixed-bidi string with a U+00B7 separator — it will need explicit bidi isolates (U+2068/U+2069) or two separate Text spans, or the middle dot will jump sides.
• Decide now whether prices render in Western (65.42) or Arabic-Indic (٦٥٫٤٢) digits, and whether the decimal separator changes. This affects the tabular-figures assumption.
• "Sign out", "Edit", "Language" are short strings that grow ~30-50% in Arabic — the Language row is a space-between Row and will handle it, but "Edit" sits next to a letterspaced uppercase label and can collide; give the label Expanded and the action a fixed trailing slot.
• The `bRise` entry animation translates on Y only, so it is direction-safe. The nav pill's `translateX(300%)` for the You tab is NOT — in RTL the You tab is the leftmost, so the pill offset must be computed from the directional index.

PRODUCT RULES CHECK ON THIS SCREEN.
• No BUY/SELL/TARGET/STOP/EXPECTED-RETURN semantics appear anywhere in You — clean. Do not let the watchlist rows acquire a % change or a green/red tint during implementation; the canvas deliberately renders the price in neutral #5C554F with no delta, and #3F6B52/#A3402F are unused here.

The row has no room for a third line, so the fix is likely a single "Prices as of HH:MM · delayed Nmin" caption under the Watchlist card or in the section header opposite "Edit" — note that this collides with the existing "Edit" affordance and needs a design decision.
